newsitem.title: ERITREA: ERITREA TROOPS KILL SUSPECT IN DEATH OF BELGIANS.
newsitem.headline: ERITREA TROOPS KILL SUSPECT IN DEATH OF BELGIANS.

text.p: Eritrean troops have shot dead a man suspected of involvement in killing five Belgian tourists in Eritrea last December, a government official said on Tuesday.

Troops opened fire last month on a group of suspects close to Filfil, 40 km (25 miles) north of the capital and near the spot where one Belgian man, four Belgian women and an Eritrean driver were ambushed and killed on December 27.

"The army unit followed (the group) and eventually shot at them. They killed one and probably wounded another because there was a trail of blood in the bush," said Tewolde WoldeMikael, a senior foreign ministry official.
He said other members of the suspected group fled possibly to neighbouring Sudan.
